description: Performance monitors of a running game, about once a second: FPS, frame times, object, node and orphan-node counts, memory, draw calls, physics, plus any custom monitors the game registers. Returns: latest values, and a history of the requested monitors - a rising orphan count is the usual sign of a leak.

names.description: Monitors to return history for, e.g. ['OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT']

session_id.description: Session from runtime_run. Required only when several games run.

name: runtime_monitors
